environment.display: private Xvfb 1280x1024x24, X11; 1100x800 viewer at display origin, no window manager
environment.role: local viewer, synthetic four-node export.json, no external account
environment.isolation: new HOME, XDG runtime/config/data directories and session bus for each replay

setup: Launch compiled viewer with positional export.json fixture.
Pause, search A, select the result and enable Neighbors.

scenarios.name: Save SVG
steps: Press Export, type current.svg in the real GTK chooser, verify painted filename and Save/Cancel controls, press Return, verify the saved status.
scenarios.expected: Typed destination saved; SVG reopens with Unicode neighborhood, weighted edges and loop.

scenarios.name: Cancel
steps: Press Export, type cancelled.svg, verify painted chooser, press Escape, wait for dismissal, assert rendered Export cancelled and compare all destination filenames and bytes.
scenarios.expected: Visible cancellation status and byte-identical directory contents.

scenarios.name: Save PNG
steps: Press Export, type current.png, verify painted chooser, press Return and verify saved status; decode the output with Pillow.
scenarios.expected: 1068x560 PNG; three node centers match independent PDF raster.

scenarios.name: Save PDF
steps: Press Export, type current.pdf, verify painted chooser, press Return and verify saved status; reopen with PDFium, extract text and rasterize.
scenarios.expected: One page with expected Unicode text; exported/native graph labels and node centers agree.

scenarios.name: Save again
steps: Press Export, type recovered.svg, verify painted chooser, press Return and verify saved status; compare first and final SVG bytes.

scenarios: Stability begins only after expected chooser text paints
pixel_regression_tests.input: retained real GTK/X11 positive and negative captures; ImageGrab is substituted, real Tesseract is used

privacy.scope: all retained PNG metadata, PDF metadata and extracted text, SVG and JSON text, changed source/docs and filenames; visual inspection of every refreshed chooser/result and both controls
privacy.observed: Synthetic graph labels and disposable container paths only; no private source context or credentials found.

skipped: Fresh compiler rebuild on either platform
Mac Save/reopen through NSSavePanel (open; earlier consent-free OK attempt timed out, no practical new method established)
Physical input and physical Linux hardware

assessment.confidence: high for the observed GTK/X11 route and two rejection controls
assessment.would_change_conclusion: Failed supported-host rerun, source/binary identity mismatch, or reopened-export discrepancy.
